explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to plants with OAI classifications and recalls before and after the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the dextrose monohydrate shortage on 2022-01-13 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21, spanning 57 months.
B. Braun's plant received an OAI classification letter dated 2020-10-22, 448 days before the shortage posting, and a subsequent OAI inspection ended 2025-11-21.

Baxter plants have multiple OAI inspections: FEI 1025114 with OAI inspections ending 2012-11-16, 2016-02-26, 2024-02-09, and 2024-08-01; FEI 1416980 with OAI inspections ending 2024-08-01 and 2026-04-02; FEI 2618677 with OAI inspections ending 2010-08-26, 2013-04-19, 2014-02-11, 2015-05-01, and 2016-10-03.
Hospira's plant (FEI 1021343) had OAI inspections ending 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, and 2011-08-04, with a VAI inspection ending 2019-11-21, 784 days before the shortage posting.

Class I recall D-1257-2020 by B. Braun started 2020-04-18 (635 days before posting) and Class II recalls by Baxter and B. Braun occurred both before and after the posting, including recalls D-0076-2021 (463 days before), D-0434-2023 (412 days after), D-0543-2023 (426 days after), D-0579-2023 (481 days after), and D-1141-2023 (575 days after).
The rule-identified best option is to buy from Civica Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and uses InfoRLife SA as its plant.

Q-b35b5f.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%dextrose%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%dextrose%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-6880b7.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('60b6d7c3-0164-46c9-aa38-b5aa1c31a5d5', '8ccb10fe-75a5-440b-8cd4-b11f4e98f7b0', '7dff29d9-522d-40eb-a9d9-42377912d640', '3bb406a9-f5cb-403a-b1bb-5c4facbea3d5', '4ed365da-4e62-4329-c1b9-c197ab4fb6e1', '231d95a6-5e5f-4a45-a92b-d3d16ef0a7ca', '085614c7-ada4-4e2c-87c0-c9bc2f18365a') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-23a3b4.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%dextrose%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-856f5d.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%dextrose%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-044f52.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%dextrose%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-5612a9.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1025114', '1416980', '2649614', '2618677', '3005164365', '1021343', '2021236', '3005468265', '3008461619', '3008887707', '3002608066', '3002851530', '3008316085', '1910565', '1628454', '2016148') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-9cdc20.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1025114', '1416980', '2649614', '2618677', '3005164365', '1021343', '2021236') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('b braun', 'inforlife for sandoz', 'baxter', 'bieffe medital', 'hospira')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-04e9c6.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('b braun', 'inforlife for sandoz', 'baxter', 'bieffe medital', 'hospira', 'b braun medical', 'sandoz') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%dextrose%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-32df5e.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00264151031', '00264738750', '00264959410', '00338001702', '00338002302', '00409664802', '00781328809', '00264752000')

Q-90ddd8.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%dextrose%'
